## Purpose
SSHPeaches is an Android SSH/Mosh client (minimum Android 8.0 / API 26) for connecting to servers, managing saved hosts and keys, transferring files (SFTP/SCP), setting up local port forwards, storing command snippets, and reusing settings. It prioritizes touch-friendly UX, security (host key verification, PIN/biometrics, encrypted storage), and offline-first operation via QR-based import/export of hosts, identities, forwards, and settings. It is intended for SREs, indie developers, and IT consultants who need dependable remote access without relying on cloud sync. (Traceable to: README.md, docs/user-wiki/*.md and task-2-summary.json.)

## Main Capabilities
Documented and reflected in source structure:
- SSH terminal sessions + Mosh transport option.
- SFTP file browsing/transfers and SCP quick copies.
- Hosts management: save/edit/delete, groups (collapsible), search, sort (Last Used / Alphabetical), launch SSH/SFTP/SCP/Info/QR, import from OpenSSH config, attach defaults (forward, snippet, transport).
- Identities: add/import private keys (paste/file), fingerprints, QR share/import (optional export passphrase), groups/favorites.
- Port Forwards: local (-L) only; bind/dest, associate with hosts for auto-start, enable/disable, QR share, toggle during session.
- Snippets: reusable commands (with variable refs), run against sessions, QR share/import, groups.
- Home: open sessions, favorites (grouped by type), mixed recents; welcome/add buttons when empty.
- Quick Connect (ad-hoc), Keyboard Editor (compact row customization), Theme Editor (terminal profiles), Settings (theme, background sessions, emulation, security/lock, host key behavior, diagnostics opt-in).
- Extras: OS/distro icon inference post-connect, widgets (quick connect + sessions), uptime monitoring + notifications, QR multi-frame with checksum support.

Remote forwards (-R/-D) and Telnet/local shell are out of scope. (Traceable to: README.md, docs/user-wiki/User-Guide.md + Getting-Started.md + task-2-summary.json, Product-Blueprint.md, AndroidManifest.xml, model classes.)

## Repository Layout
Single-repo Gradle project (root name "SSHPeaches"):
- Root: README.md, LICENSE, CHANGELOG.md, build.gradle.kts, settings.gradle.kts, gradlew*, firebase.json, gradle.properties, docs/, prompt_*.txt (ephemeral).

- docs/: user-wiki/ (Home.md, Getting-Started.md, User-Guide.md, Troubleshooting.md), developer/ (Developer-Home.md, Product-Blueprint.md, UI-Design-Notes.md), task-2-summary.json, task-3-summary.json, plans/.
- functions/: Node.js Firebase functions (package.json + index.js).
- macrobenchmark/: performance module.
- third_party/termux-playstore/: vendored terminal-emulator + terminal-view.
- tools/live-ssh-server/: Kotlin/JVM test server (Apache SSHD) with its own build.gradle.kts.
- build/ (and app/build/): generated artifacts only.

(Traceable to: repeated list_dir on ., app/, docs/, app/src/main/java, test dirs; direct reads of settings.gradle.kts, build files, manifest.)

## Architecture Overview
- UI: MainActivity (FragmentActivity) hosts Compose (SSHPeachesRoot + *Screen.kt files). Material 3 + adaptive layout. Separate non-Compose terminal stack.
- State: AppViewModel (central StateFlow<AppUiState>) aggregates repo + SettingsStore + lock state. Compose screens collect state.
- Persistence: Room (SshPeachesDatabase v9 with HostEntity, IdentityEntity, PortForwardEntity, SnippetEntity + uptime entities; DAOs + Mappers + Converters), DataStore Preferences (most settings), SecurityManager (EncryptedSharedPreferences + Keystore for secrets/PIN).
- Live sessions: SessionService (foreground, dataSync type) owns SSHClient (sshj), SFTPClient/SCPFileTransfer, Mosh sessions (native unpack via MoshRuntime), PTY, transfers, port forwards, notifications, and widget updates. Binds to MainActivity.
- SSH: SshClientProvider (sshj 0.40.0 factory + host key verifier/prompts + Ed25519/BC). IdentityKeyInstaller.
- Terminal: TermuxTerminalEngine (wraps TerminalEmulator) + TerminalRenderView (custom View + gestures/scale) + TerminalInputRouter.
- Other: WorkManager (UptimeWorker + optional diagnostics), QR encode/decode (multi-frame, ZXing capture activities), AppContainer (repo wiring), OpenSshConfigImporter, widgets, uptime monitor/scheduler/notifications.
- Navigation: Compose + drawer destinations.
